answer_1.quote: We verify the effectiveness of LoRA-Flow on six different generation tasks, and the results show that LoRA-Flow can consistently outperform the baselines that use task-level fusion weights (e.g., LoRA-Hub).
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include solutions to multilingual math problems and code in various languages based on instructions.

answer_2.quote: We report the accuracy and the pass@1 score on MGSM and HumanEval, respectively.

answer_4.quote: we employed two annotators for each language... Each piece of data is sequentially reviewed by two independent annotators.
answer_4.guideline: The primary areas of review and optimization include: • Correctness of the mathematical problem-solving process. • Correctness of the mathematical problem format... • Whether the code part of the code generation problems remains consistent with that in the original data... • Correctness of the code data format... • Overall fluency of the translated sentence.
criteria: Correctness of the mathematical problem-solving process
Correctness of the mathematical problem format
Consistency of code with original data
Correctness of the code data format
Overall fluency of the translated sentence
